about.description: Job titles the gate's rules left out that Claude Sonnet 5.5 and Claude Opus 5.5 both found in one of the site's ISCO-08 unit groups, read once (builder/tools/gate-misses.mjs, 2026-10-20) over every advert in the store: the title as the gate reads it (matchableTitle), and its unit group. The gate's last way in: a title its rules leave out, with no code of its source's, is in when it is here.
